fusions.name: Kicked Turf
fusions.desc: Kicks a clod of turf that deals 3 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Trampling Drive
fusions.desc: Drives forward through a wide cone 4 tiles long, dealing 13 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Steady Pace
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 15% for 8 seconds and carries you 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fresh Legs
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
